description: The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration with displays 1, 2, and 3, where the user is configuring multiple display settings including brightness, resolution (2560 x 1440), and scale options.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display settings, showing a multi-monitor configuration with displays 1, 2, and 3, where the user is configuring display arrangement, brightness, scale (100%), resolution (2560 × 1440), and orientation options.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor setup with 3 displays where the user is configuring display arrangement, brightness (slider around 50%), scale (100%), and resolution (2560 × 1440) settings.

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to System > Display, showing a multi-monitor configuration with displays 1, 2, and 3 visible, where the user is adjusting display settings including brightness, night light, scale (100%), and resolution (2560 x 1440).

The Windows 11 Settings app is open to the System > Display page, showing a dual-monitor setup (displays 1 and 2|3) with options for multiple displays, brightness, night light, HDR, scale (100%), resolution (2560 x 1440), and landscape orientation.
